method.entry: close on signal day; risk setups evaluated from next trading day
method.technical_signal: NEW BULLISH: Bullish >=25, confluence >=3/5, previous non-Bullish OR score delta >=15
method.trade_journal: fresh Bullish + score >=25 + confluence >=3/5 + RSI 50-<70 + confirmed Fibonacci pivots + R:R >=1.5
method.early_signals: Bullish trend with breakout/pullback rules; ATR14 SL=1.5 ATR, TP1=2.25 ATR, TP2=3 ATR
method.ambiguity: if TP and SL are both touched on the same daily bar, classify STOP LOSS conservatively
method.costs: gross results; fees, tax, slippage and spread are not modeled
